coordinate_space: Exact DSBI provided deskewed +recto.jpg pixel-index centers from raw TXT; no angle re-application; actual middle row preserved.
source_binding: Each sidecar record exactly rederived at startup from hash-bound TRAIN annotation and (source,row,col,annotation_line,mask), with original image/cache/TRAIN membership separately audited.
visibility: Safe center hull 0<=x<=W-1,0<=y<=H-1 after source crop, resize and every affine/rotation raster. Occupied survivors AND across stages; lost points cannot recover.
geometry_targets: Only still-crossing known DSBI source boxes with occupied survivors: regress visible box clamped to canvas, objectness1, all six bits -1. This is fragment rejection geometry, not the full source cell box.
complete_target_policy: Complete cells keep full original target; complete targets overwrite colliding fragment targets.
excluded: Angelina partials, unlisted DSBI slots, mask-zero cells, no surviving occupied points, earlier cut boxes now fully inside, visible fragments below4x12, full-span width/height.
default_off: Original pixels, box transforms, RNG draws, target tensors, sample order and negative exposure must match run19 exactly before launch.
limitations: Surviving geometric occupied centers prove annotated point presence, not guaranteed post-blur optical visibility.
Overlapping/colliding cells may suppress fragments; this does not create a universal rejection guarantee.
Known external607 and14 rejection diagnostics are already observed development regressions, never independent physical holdout.
selection: Unchanged v13 control plus eligible8-10 on frozen405 natural+stress; weak-peaks-v2 grid and >=95percent accepted precision separately per group. External607/44/66 never select checkpoints/thresholds.
